products.name: Living Lettuce
products.description: Fresh, non-GMO living butter lettuce grown using proprietary hybrid vertical and greenhouse farming technology, harvested with roots intact and distributed to retail customers. Production requires controlled environment agriculture (CEA) facilities and specialized packaging for retail sale.

products.name: Packaged Leafy Greens
products.description: Ready-to-eat loose leaf lettuce blends and specialty greens, including arugula and cress, grown in CEA facilities and packaged for retail sale. Production involves hybrid vertical and greenhouse farming, automated harvesting, and proprietary packaging technology.

products.name: Value-Added Salad Kits
products.description: Pre-packaged salad kits containing blends of leafy greens and additional ingredients, produced in CEA facilities and distributed to retail customers. Production includes automated harvesting, processing, and packaging for convenience and freshness.

products.name: Organic Leafy Greens
products.description: Certified organic versions of living and loose leaf lettuce and specialty greens, grown using organic methods in CEA greenhouses and packaged for retail sale. Production requires compliance with organic standards and specialized handling.

products.name: Specialty Greens and Herbs
products.description: Specialty greens such as arugula and cress, and herbs, grown in controlled environment agriculture facilities and distributed as packaged products to retail customers. Production uses hybrid vertical and greenhouse farming and automated packaging.

products.name: Allogeneic CAR-T Cell Therapies for Hematologic Malignancies
products.description: Off-the-shelf, genome-edited CAR-T cell therapies manufactured from healthy donor T cells using proprietary chRDNA CRISPR genome-editing technology, designed for rapid, scalable, and broad patient access. Delivered as cryopreserved cell therapy products for infusion in patients with hematologic cancers.

products.name: Vispacabtagene regedleucel (vispa-cel) – Anti-CD19 Allogeneic CAR-T Cell Therapy
products.description: A genome-edited, allogeneic CAR-T cell therapy targeting CD19-positive hematologic malignancies, produced using chRDNA technology with PD-1 knockout for enhanced activity. Manufactured in advance and delivered as a cryopreserved, off-the-shelf product for infusion in patients with relapsed or refractory B cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma.

products.name: CB-011 – Anti-BCMA Allogeneic CAR-T Cell Therapy
products.description: A genome-edited, allogeneic CAR-T cell therapy targeting BCMA-positive multiple myeloma, incorporating immune cloaking edits for enhanced persistence. Produced using chRDNA technology and delivered as a cryopreserved, off-the-shelf product for infusion in patients with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma.

products.name: Home Improvement Products
products.description: A wide assortment of home improvement products, building materials, lawn and garden products, décor products, and facilities MRO products sold through physical stores and online platforms. These products are sourced globally and delivered via a large distribution and fulfillment network.

products.name: Installation Services
products.description: Professional installation services for home improvement projects such as flooring, water heaters, bath, garage doors, cabinets, countertops, sheds, HVAC systems, windows, and window coverings, delivered in-store, online, or through in-home consultations.

products.name: Tool and Equipment Rental
products.description: Rental of tools and equipment for home improvement and construction projects, available at many store locations, providing value and convenience for both professional and consumer customers.

products.name: MRO Products and Related Services
products.description: Facilities maintenance, repair, and operations (MRO) products and related value-added services, primarily serving multifamily, hospitality, healthcare, and government housing facilities, delivered through specialized subsidiaries and online platforms.

products.name: Roofing and Exterior Building Products Distribution
products.description: Distribution of residential and commercial roofing products and complementary exterior building materials to professional roofers and contractors, utilizing a network of distribution centers and delivery equipment.

products.name: Interior and Construction Products Distribution
products.description: Distribution of specialty interior building products such as drywall, ceilings, steel framing, and other complementary construction products to professional contractors, delivered through dedicated distribution centers and logistics networks.

products.name: Landscape Supplies Distribution
products.description: Distribution of landscape supplies to professional landscapers and contractors, including delivery to job sites via a network of specialized branches and distribution centers.

products.name: Pool Supplies Distribution
products.description: Distribution of swimming pool supplies to professional pool contractors, utilizing specialized distribution centers and delivery equipment for efficient job site delivery.

products.name: Personal and Business Deposit Products
products.description: Traditional deposit products including personal and business checking and savings accounts, money market, and time deposits, delivered through physical branches and digital banking platforms.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: A broad range of lending products for businesses, including commercial real estate loans, construction finance, working capital lines of credit, asset-based lending, asset-backed finance, project finance, equipment financing, and loan syndication, requiring significant financial capital and underwriting expertise.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Lending
products.description: Mortgage and home lending products for individuals, including loans for home purchase and refinancing, delivered through branch and digital channels and subject to regulatory requirements.

products.name: Trade Finance and Letters of Credit
products.description: Trade finance solutions such as letters of credit and related services to facilitate cross-border business transactions, leveraging international banking infrastructure and regulatory expertise.

products.name: Treasury Management Services
products.description: Treasury management solutions for businesses, including cash management, payments, and liquidity services, delivered via digital and in-person channels.

products.name: Foreign Exchange and Derivatives Services
products.description: Foreign exchange services and derivative contracts (interest rate, energy commodity, and FX contracts) for clients managing currency and financial risks, requiring specialized financial expertise and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Wealth management and advisory services for individuals and businesses, including investment and financial planning, delivered through licensed professionals and digital platforms.

products.name: Digital Banking Services
products.description: Mobile and online banking platforms offering a full suite of banking services to consumers and businesses, requiring ongoing technology investment and digital infrastructure.

products.name: Broker-Dealer Services
products.description: Broker-dealer services provided through a registered subsidiary, including securities brokerage and related investment services, subject to SEC and FINRA regulation.

products.name: Cinema Exhibition Services
products.description: Operation of 58 cinemas across the United States, Australia, and New Zealand, providing theatrical motion picture exhibition, including mainstream and specialty films, with amenities such as luxury recliner seating, premium large format auditoriums, and enhanced food and beverage offerings. Delivered through physical venues equipped with advanced projection and sound technology, and supported by digital ticketing and loyalty programs.

products.name: Live Theatre Venue Licensing
products.description: Ownership and licensing of two Off-Broadway style live theatres in Manhattan, providing space for producers of theatrical productions. Revenue is generated from licensing theatre auditoriums and providing box office and concessions services. The service is delivered through physical venues owned and managed by the company.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Ownership, development, and leasing of retail, office, and commercial properties, including flagship properties such as 44 Union Square in New York and entertainment-themed centers in Australia. Properties are leased to third-party tenants, including retailers, supermarkets, and professional services, generating rental income. Delivered through physical real estate assets managed and improved by the company.

products.name: Real Estate Development and Monetization
products.description: Acquisition, development, improvement, and selective monetization (sale) of real estate assets, including land and properties held for future development or redevelopment. This includes activities such as property sales, redevelopment projects, and joint ventures, primarily to generate liquidity and long-term value. Delivered through physical asset management and transactions.

products.name: Multicloud Application Delivery and Security Solutions
products.description: A comprehensive suite of software, SaaS, and managed services that optimize and secure applications and APIs across on-premises, cloud, and edge environments. Delivered via packaged software, SaaS, and managed service models, these solutions leverage AI and machine learning for performance and security.

products.name: F5 Distributed Cloud Services
products.description: A unified SaaS and managed services platform providing security, networking, and application management for applications across hybrid, multicloud, and edge environments. Includes offerings for web app and API protection, DDoS mitigation, bot defense, multi-cloud networking, DNS, CDN, and managed Kubernetes application orchestration.

products.name: F5 NGINX Application Delivery Solutions
products.description: A suite of lightweight, agile software solutions for modern, container-native, and microservices-based applications and APIs, including load balancing, web server, API gateway, ingress controller for Kubernetes, and WAF. Delivered as packaged software subscriptions and SaaS management platforms.

products.name: F5 BIG-IP Application Delivery and Security Solutions
products.description: Feature-rich, highly programmable and configurable software and hardware systems for legacy and traditional enterprise applications, providing application delivery, security, access management, DDoS protection, and automation. Delivered as packaged software (subscription/perpetual) and high-performance hardware systems.

products.name: High-Performance Hardware Systems (F5 BIG-IP Systems)
products.description: Custom hardware appliances designed to run F5 BIG-IP software modules, leveraging FPGA and off-the-shelf silicon for enhanced automation, multi-tenancy, and migration capabilities. Manufactured by third-party partners and distributed globally.

products.name: Global Services (Maintenance, Consulting, Training, Technical Support)
products.description: A broad range of professional services including maintenance, consulting, training, and technical support to assist customers in deploying, managing, and optimizing F5 solutions. Delivered globally by F5's services organization.

products.name: GPCR-Targeted Biologic Therapeutics
products.description: Therapeutic proteins and antibodies designed to modulate G-protein coupled receptors (GPCRs), discovered and developed using proprietary protein engineering and yeast display technology. These biologics are manufactured through third-party contract development and manufacturing organizations and delivered as injectable medicines for clinical and, if approved, commercial use.

products.name: TX45 (Fc-Relaxin Fusion Protein)
products.description: A proprietary Fc-relaxin fusion protein biologic that activates the RXFP1 GPCR, developed for the treatment of Group 2 pulmonary hypertension with heart failure (PH-HFpEF), Group 3 PH-ILD, and potentially other fibrotic or vasoconstrictive diseases. Manufactured via protein engineering and delivered as an injectable therapeutic, pending regulatory approval.

products.name: TX2100 (APJ VHH-Fc Fusion Antagonist Antibody)
products.description: A VHH-Fc fusion antagonist antibody biologic targeting the APJ (apelin) GPCR, under development for hereditary hemorrhagic telangiectasia (HHT). Produced using advanced protein engineering and delivered as an injectable medicine, subject to clinical and regulatory progress.

products.name: GPCR Modulator Bispecific for Fibrosis
products.description: A bispecific biologic molecule in preclinical development, designed to target two GPCRs simultaneously for the treatment of fibrotic diseases. Utilizes proprietary protein engineering and yeast display technology for discovery and is intended for injectable delivery upon successful development.

products.name: Mattresses
products.description: Manufactured using proprietary Hyper-Elastic Polymer (Gelflex Grid) technology, Purple's mattresses are produced in-house at their Georgia facility and offered in multiple collections (Essentials, Restore, Rejuvenate) across a range of comfort levels and price points. Sold through direct-to-consumer and wholesale channels.

products.name: Pillows
products.description: A range of pillows designed and manufactured using proprietary Gelflex Grid and other materials, tailored for different sleep preferences. Includes multiple models with unique features such as adjustability, cooling, and ergonomic support. Manufactured in-house and sold through various channels.

products.name: Seat Cushions
products.description: Seat and back cushions produced using proprietary Gelflex Grid technology, manufactured in-house in various sizes and shapes to provide pressure relief and comfort for seating applications.

products.name: Adjustable and Platform Bases
products.description: A full line of smart adjustable bases and platform bed foundations, designed in-house or in partnership, to pair with Purple mattresses. Features include adjustable positions, presets, under-bed lighting, and wireless controls. Some products are outsourced and resold.

products.name: Sheets and Bedding Accessories
products.description: Stretchy, breathable sheets and bedding accessories (including pillowcases, blankets, duvets) designed to maximize the performance of Purple mattresses and pillows. Some products are developed in-house, others are outsourced and resold.

products.name: Mattress Protectors
products.description: Premium, stretchy, breathable, and waterproof mattress protectors designed to optimize the functionality of Purple mattresses. Outsourced and resold, but designed to complement proprietary mattress technology.

products.name: Community Banking Services
products.description: Traditional banking services including deposit accounts (checking, savings, money market, certificates of deposit, IRAs) and lending products (one- to four-family, multi-family, commercial real estate, construction and land, home equity, commercial business, and consumer loans) delivered through physical branches in Wisconsin. Requires regulated infrastructure, in-person and digital service, and financial capital.

products.name: Mortgage Banking Services
products.description: Origination of single-family residential mortgage loans for sale into the secondary market, primarily through Waterstone Mortgage Corporation, with operations in 24 states. Involves regulated origination, underwriting, and sale of loans, delivered via a distributed office network and digital channels.

products.name: Investment Securities Portfolio
products.description: Management and sale of investment securities including mortgage-backed securities, collateralized mortgage obligations, private-label mortgage-backed securities, municipal obligations, and other debt securities. Primarily managed for the company’s own balance sheet, but may include some investment products for customers. Requires financial capital and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Steelmaking Coal (Hard Coking Coal)
products.description: Premium quality hard coking coal (HCC) mined from underground mines in Alabama using longwall extraction technology, processed and blended at preparation facilities, and exported primarily to steel manufacturers in Europe, South America, and Asia. Delivery involves physical mining, processing, and global logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Natural Gas (Coal Mine Methane)
products.description: Natural gas extracted from coal seams as a byproduct of mining operations, processed through a low-quality gas plant to improve quality, and sold to external customers as fuel. Production requires gas extraction infrastructure and gas processing technology.

products.name: Single-Family Homes
products.description: Development, design, construction, marketing, and sale of single-family attached and detached homes, primarily move-in-ready, under the Century Communities and Century Complete brands. Homes are built using physical construction, subcontracted labor, and are sold through in-person and digital channels.

products.name: Multi-Family Rental Properties
products.description: Development, construction, management, and sales of multi-family rental properties, currently all located in Colorado, involving physical construction and property management services.

products.name: Mortgage Origination Services
products.description: Origination and sale of residential mortgage loans, primarily for homebuyers of Century Communities homes, through a wholly owned subsidiary. Involves financial capital, regulatory compliance, and loan servicing or sale in the secondary market.

products.name: Title and Escrow Services
products.description: Provision of title insurance and escrow services to homebuyers, ensuring clear property titles and facilitating real estate transactions. Delivered through licensed subsidiaries and involves regulated financial and legal processes.

products.name: Homeowners Insurance Brokerage
products.description: Brokerage of homeowners insurance policies for homebuyers, delivered through a licensed subsidiary, involving regulated insurance products and customer service.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides a broad range of loans to businesses, including revolving lines of credit, term loans, and government-guaranteed loans (SBA, USDA), primarily to small and mid-sized businesses. Lending is delivered through in-person banking relationships and is subject to underwriting and regulatory requirements.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Offers loans for the purchase, development, and construction of commercial real estate, including owner-occupied and non-owner-occupied properties, multi-family, retail, office, industrial, hotel, and LIHTC projects. Loans are secured by real estate and delivered through branch networks.

products.name: Residential Real Estate Lending
products.description: Provides mortgage loans for 1-4 family residential properties, including both conforming and non-conforming loans, with many sold into the secondary market. Loans are originated through branch offices and follow Freddie Mac and Fannie Mae guidelines.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Offers a variety of consumer loans, including home equity loans and lines of credit, home improvement, motor vehicle, signature loans, and small personal credit lines. These are delivered through branch networks and subject to specific credit guidelines.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Accepts a full range of deposit products for consumers and businesses, including checking, savings, money market, and time deposit accounts. Deposits are insured by the FDIC and accessed through branch locations.

products.name: Trust and Asset Management Services
products.description: Provides trust, investment advisory, and asset management services to individuals and institutions, delivered through dedicated trust departments at subsidiary banks. Services include fiduciary management and investment advisory for client assets.

products.name: Interest Rate Swap Services
products.description: Offers back-to-back interest rate swaps to commercial borrowers, allowing clients to pay fixed rates while the bank receives variable rates and upfront fees. These are structured and executed by the bank for qualified commercial clients.

products.name: Equipment Financing and Leasing (Discontinued)
products.description: Previously provided direct financing leases and equipment financing agreements for machinery and equipment to commercial and industrial businesses through its m2 subsidiary. This service was discontinued for new business in 2024.

products.name: Women's Health Products
products.description: Prescription pharmaceuticals focused on contraception (implants, rings, pills), fertility (gonadotropins, GnRH antagonists), and select other conditions affecting women. Products are manufactured at internal facilities and distributed globally via healthcare providers and pharmacies.

products.name: Biosimilars
products.description: Biological medicines highly similar to reference biologics, spanning immunology and oncology indications. Products are manufactured via partnerships and distributed globally, requiring advanced biologics manufacturing and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Established Brands (General Medicines)
products.description: A portfolio of mature, branded pharmaceuticals in cardiovascular, respiratory, dermatology, bone health, and non-opioid pain management. Products are manufactured at internal sites and distributed globally, with most having lost exclusivity and facing generic competition.

products.name: Other Established Brands
products.description: Additional mature pharmaceutical products, including those for migraine prevention, benign prostatic hyperplasia, and male pattern hair loss, distributed under licensing or distribution agreements in select markets.

products.name: Tibulizumab (ZB-106)
products.description: A humanized bispecific antibody that binds and neutralizes both IL-17A and BAFF, designed to modulate complementary T cell– and B cell–associated immune pathways. Manufactured via contract manufacturing organizations under cGMP, delivered as a subcutaneous injection. Currently in Phase 2 clinical trials for hidradenitis suppurativa and diffuse cutaneous systemic sclerosis.

products.name: Crebankitug (ZB-168)
products.description: A fully human IgG1 monoclonal antibody targeting interleukin-7 receptor alpha (IL-7Rα), designed to inhibit signaling mediated by both IL-7 and TSLP. Manufactured via contract manufacturing organizations, delivered via intravenous infusion or subcutaneous injection. Previously evaluated in Phase 1/1b trials; future development strategies under assessment.

products.name: Torudokimab (ZB-880)
products.description: A fully human IgG4 monoclonal antibody that binds and neutralizes soluble human IL-33, targeting the IL-33/ST2 signaling pathway. Manufactured via contract manufacturing organizations, delivered via intravenous infusion or subcutaneous injection. Previously evaluated in Phase 1 and Phase 2 trials; future development strategies under assessment.

products.name: Specialty Property and Casualty Insurance
products.description: Provides a range of specialty property and casualty insurance products to businesses and organizations globally, delivered through underwriting expertise and distributed via brokers and managing general agents. Requires regulated infrastructure, significant underwriting talent, and claims management capabilities.

products.name: Reinsurance Services
products.description: Offers property, casualty, and specialty reinsurance on both treaty and facultative bases to insurance companies worldwide, utilizing both proportional and non-proportional structures. Delivered through global reinsurance subsidiaries and Lloyd’s syndicates, requiring significant financial capital and actuarial expertise.

products.name: Mortgage Insurance and Reinsurance
products.description: Provides private mortgage insurance and reinsurance products to mortgage lenders and investors in the U.S. and internationally, including participation in government-sponsored enterprise (GSE) credit risk-sharing transactions. Delivered through regulated insurance entities and requires specialized underwriting, analytics, and compliance with GSE and local regulations.

products.name: Movie Theatre Exhibition Services
products.description: Operation of movie theatres under various brands, providing film exhibition to the public with amenities such as premium large format screens, luxury recliner seating, digital projection, and reserved seating. Delivered through physical theatre locations across multiple states.

products.name: Theatre Food and Beverage Services
products.description: Provision of food and beverage offerings in theatres, including traditional concessions, in-theatre dining, full-service bars, and branded dining concepts. Delivered through in-lobby stands, restaurants, and seat delivery, often leveraging proprietary brands.

products.name: Hotel and Resort Lodging Services
products.description: Ownership and operation of full-service and limited-service hotels and resorts, offering guest accommodations, amenities, and related services. Delivered through company-owned and managed properties in multiple states.

products.name: Hotel and Resort Management Services
products.description: Management of hotels, resorts, and other hospitality properties for third parties under long-term contracts, including operational oversight, staffing, and revenue management. Delivered through management agreements with property owners.

products.name: Event and Meeting Services
products.description: Provision of meeting, event, and banquet facilities and services at hotels and resorts, including ballrooms, conference centers, and event planning. Delivered through dedicated spaces and staff at owned and managed properties.

products.name: Family Entertainment Center Services
products.description: Operation of a family entertainment center offering indoor amusement, arcade games, laser tag, miniature golf, and dining. Delivered through a dedicated facility adjacent to a theatre location.

products.name: Commercial Laundry Services
products.description: Provision of commercial laundry services for hospitality industry clients, including hotels and resorts, both company-owned and unaffiliated. Delivered through a dedicated business unit processing large volumes of linen.

products.name: Restaurant and Bar Services
products.description: Operation of branded and signature restaurants and bars, both within hotels and as standalone venues, offering dining and beverage services to guests and the public. Delivered through physical restaurant locations and hotel outlets.

products.name: Waterpark and Resort Entertainment Services
products.description: Operation and management of indoor/outdoor waterparks and entertainment amenities at resort properties, including water attractions, arcades, and family activities. Delivered through dedicated facilities at managed resorts.

products.name: Excess and Surplus (E&S) Casualty Insurance
products.description: Commercial casualty insurance policies for small and medium-sized businesses, underwritten on a non-admitted (E&S) basis, focusing on lower-limit, frequency-driven risks. Delivered through licensed surplus lines brokers and wholesale agents, using a technology-driven, productionized underwriting model.

products.name: Excess and Surplus (E&S) Property Insurance
products.description: Commercial property insurance policies for small and medium-sized businesses, underwritten on a non-admitted (E&S) basis, emphasizing short-tail, lower-severity exposures with limited catastrophe risk. Distributed via surplus lines brokers and wholesale agents, supported by automated and standardized underwriting processes.

products.name: Upright MRI Scanners
products.description: Designs, manufactures, sells, and services Upright® MRI scanners, which are whole-body, open, non-claustrophobic MRI systems allowing imaging in multiple patient positions. These are physically manufactured medical devices installed at customer sites and require ongoing service and upgrades.

products.name: MRI Scanner Service and Upgrades
products.description: Provides service, maintenance, and hardware/software upgrades for installed Upright® MRI scanners and, through subsidiaries, for MRI scanners manufactured by other companies. This is delivered via in-person technical support and remote software updates.

products.name: Diagnostic Imaging Services
products.description: Operates and manages outpatient diagnostic imaging facilities that provide MRI and ancillary imaging services (including x-ray and extremity MRI) to patients. Services are delivered in-person by technologists and physicians at physical locations owned or managed by the company or its subsidiaries.

products.name: Physician and Diagnostic Facility Management Services
products.description: Provides comprehensive non-medical management services to diagnostic imaging facilities, including administrative, billing, IT, compliance, marketing, and facility operations. These are delivered as ongoing service contracts to external physician-owned imaging centers.

products.name: SwiftMR Software Distribution
products.description: Distributes SwiftMR™ software, which enhances image quality and efficiency for MRI scanners, to its installed base and other MRI operators. This is a digital software product sold to external customers.

products.name: Apparel and Accessories
products.description: Solution-based apparel, swimwear, outerwear, accessories, and footwear designed and sourced by Lands’ End, sold primarily through digital channels and retail stores. Products are manufactured by independent vendors globally and delivered via eCommerce, third-party marketplaces, and company-operated stores.

products.name: Home Products
products.description: A range of home goods produced by independent manufacturers and sold through digital and retail channels, leveraging the company’s global sourcing and distribution network.

products.name: Uniform Solutions
products.description: Uniforms and logo apparel for businesses and schools, including employee and student uniforms, sold primarily through the Outfitters distribution channel. Products are sourced globally and delivered via digital and direct sales.

products.name: Brand Licensing
products.description: Licensing of the Lands’ End brand and trademarks to third parties, generating royalty income and expanding the brand into new categories and channels. Includes fulfillment services for certain licensees.

products.name: Molecular Diagnostic Systems and Assays
products.description: Integrated, fully automated molecular diagnostic platforms (Panther, Panther Fusion) and a broad menu of proprietary assays for detection and quantitation of infectious diseases, women's health conditions, and transplant monitoring. These are manufactured using advanced nucleic acid extraction, amplification, and detection technologies, and delivered as instruments and consumables to clinical laboratories and hospitals.

products.name: Cytology Systems and Digital Diagnostics
products.description: Automated cytology processing and imaging systems (ThinPrep System, Genius Digital Diagnostics System) for cervical cancer screening and other cytology applications, combining proprietary sample preparation, imaging, and AI-based analysis. Delivered as instruments, consumables, and software to laboratories and healthcare providers.

products.name: Oncology Laboratory Testing Services
products.description: Proprietary laboratory-developed gene expression tests (Breast Cancer Index, CancerTYPE ID) for cancer diagnosis and treatment guidance, offered as clinical laboratory services through a CLIA-certified, CAP-accredited laboratory. Requires specialized laboratory infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Breast Imaging Systems and Software
products.description: Digital mammography and tomosynthesis systems (Selenia Dimensions, 3Dimensions), image analysis software (including AI-powered tools), and reading workstations for breast cancer screening and diagnostics. These are complex, regulated medical devices manufactured and installed in clinical settings.

products.name: Breast Biopsy and Surgery Products
products.description: Minimally invasive breast biopsy guidance systems (Affirm), vacuum-assisted biopsy devices (Brevera, ATEC, Eviva), surgical site markers, localization and lymphatic tracing solutions, and specimen radiology systems. These are manufactured medical devices and consumables used by clinicians for breast tissue sampling and surgery.

products.name: GYN Surgical Systems and Devices
products.description: A suite of gynecologic surgical products including tissue removal systems (MyoSure), endometrial ablation systems (NovaSure), fluid management systems (Fluent), radiofrequency ablation systems (Sonata, Acessa ProVu), vessel sealing devices (CoolSeal), and surgical staplers (JustRight). These are manufactured, regulated medical devices used in minimally invasive gynecologic procedures.

products.name: Skeletal Health Imaging Systems
products.description: Bone densitometry (Horizon DXA) and mini C-arm imaging systems (Fluoroscan Insight FD) for bone density measurement, body composition assessment, and orthopedic imaging. These are manufactured x-ray based medical devices installed in clinical and surgical settings.

products.name: Biologic Therapies for Immuno-Inflammatory Diseases
products.description: Monoclonal and multispecific antibody drugs (biologics) targeting validated pathways such as TSLP and IL-4Ra, developed through in-house R&D and licensed technology, delivered as injectable therapies for atopic, respiratory, and immunologic diseases.

products.name: Small Molecule Kinase Inhibitors for Immuno-Inflammatory Diseases
products.description: Oral small molecule drugs, including covalent inhibitors of kinases such as ITK and JAK3, discovered and optimized using the proprietary KINect platform, for the treatment of autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.

products.name: Topical JAK Inhibitors for Dermatologic Conditions
products.description: Topically applied 'soft' JAK 1/3 inhibitor drugs designed for skin activity with low systemic exposure, manufactured externally and intended for dermatologic diseases such as atopic dermatitis.

products.name: Security and Video Surveillance Solutions
products.description: End-to-end security solutions including browser-based video monitoring systems, analytics-based recognition systems, cameras, servers, and access control systems, primarily delivered as physical hardware and software platforms, often incorporating AI-based data algorithms. Products are manufactured and integrated for industrial, commercial, and governmental facilities.

products.name: Industrial Installation and Maintenance Services
products.description: Single-source industrial services including rigging, millwrighting, in-plant maintenance, equipment erection, relocation, and disassembly, delivered through skilled human labor and specialized equipment for installation and ongoing maintenance of high-precision machinery in manufacturing and processing facilities.

products.name: Hotel Franchising and Management Services
products.description: Provision of franchising, management, and licensing services for a global portfolio of branded hotel properties across luxury, premium, select, and midscale tiers. Delivered through long-term agreements with property owners, involving brand systems, centralized reservations, marketing, and operational support.

products.name: Branded Residential Real Estate Licensing and Management
products.description: Licensing of Marriott brands for the sale of residential real estate units, often co-located with hotels, and management or brand licensing of homeowners’ associations. Delivered via branding agreements with third-party developers and ongoing management or licensing services.

products.name: Timeshare Licensing and Royalty Services
products.description: Licensing of Marriott brands for timeshare properties, with revenue from fixed and variable royalty fees based on sales volumes. Delivered through agreements with third-party timeshare operators such as Marriott Vacations Worldwide.

products.name: Yacht Charter and Cruise Services
products.description: Licensing of Marriott brands for luxury yacht charter and cruise experiences, such as The Ritz-Carlton Yacht Collection, delivered through partnerships with third-party operators.

products.name: Short-Term Home Rental Services
products.description: Provision of premium and luxury tier home rental services under the Homes & Villas by Marriott Bonvoy brand, delivered digitally to travelers seeking alternatives to hotel stays.

products.name: Loyalty Program and Co-Branded Credit Card Services
products.description: Operation of the Marriott Bonvoy loyalty program and associated co-branded credit card offerings, generating revenue from card issuers and partners based on card usage and member engagement. Delivered digitally and through partnerships with financial institutions.

products.name: Leather and Leathercraft Supplies
products.description: A broad assortment of leather and leathercraft-related items, including raw leather, hand tools, hardware, liquids, and other supplies, sold through retail stores, e-commerce, and commercial channels. These products are sourced from suppliers and partially manufactured in-house, requiring physical inventory and distribution.

products.name: Leathercraft Kits and Pre-Cut Leather Pieces
products.description: Do-it-yourself kits, cut leather pieces, belt strips, straps, and Craftaid tooling templates produced in-house and sold to customers for leatherworking projects. These require physical manufacturing at the company’s production facility.

products.name: Leatherworking Machines and Equipment
products.description: Machines and specialized leatherworking equipment, including branded and patented items, sold to customers for use in leathercrafting. These are sourced and distributed through retail and online channels.

products.name: Custom Production and Assembly Services
products.description: Production services for business customers, such as cutting ('clicking'), splitting, and some assembly, tailored to commercial clients’ needs. These services are delivered using in-house manufacturing capabilities.

products.name: Leathercraft Educational Classes and Workshops
products.description: In-person and virtual classes, open workbenches, and community workshops offered in retail stores and online, teaching leatherworking skills and techniques. These are delivered through in-person instruction and digital content.

products.name: Property and Casualty Reinsurance
products.description: Provision of reinsurance coverage for property and casualty risks, including property catastrophe reinsurance, primarily through fully collateralized contracts. This involves underwriting and risk assessment, and is delivered via regulated insurance subsidiaries in the Cayman Islands.

products.name: Web3-Focused RWA Tokenization Services
products.description: Development and issuance of blockchain-based tokens representing participation in reinsurance contracts and potentially other real-world assets (RWAs). This is a digital service leveraging blockchain technology, currently in early stages with limited revenue generation.

products.name: Precision Peptide Therapies for Endocrine and Metabolic Disorders
products.description: Novel, engineered peptide-based therapeutics designed and developed using the proprietary PEP™ platform, targeting endocrine and metabolic diseases. These are manufactured via chemical synthesis and delivered as injectable drugs, with optimized pharmacokinetic profiles for improved efficacy and convenience.

products.name: Canvuparatide (MBX 2109)
products.description: A long-acting parathyroid hormone (PTH) peptide prodrug therapy for chronic hypoparathyroidism, designed for once-weekly subcutaneous injection. Manufactured using programmable prodrug and fatty acylation technologies to provide continuous, infusion-like PTH exposure.

products.name: Obesity Portfolio (including MBX 4291)
